test_title: PYST 8: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster pair.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47fc55d1448a4e304a2615e2edcf078e2c0d6f8d74bc2a848a79ef83d6e78800.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Option 1) KO-ON**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d88009ef5d813f9eecae810c0539517ad4f258ca34d9ebdc8c03935bdb4cfdac.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a48b627454de7c710e89bec2dba1fc34506e891e5ae82b2b275358783a0ed804.png] 

Option 2) CG-FG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c891c7cb4a519f5b89beeba190ec2081e1cf553a9a9023f259f9d47cce5e68b.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a4e7dcb211351b9d779719737f3b59153dd7ecacb13918c93c936eb97bee709.png] 

Option 3) AE-DE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c87e19f29529df7c925d7a32b29f339dd92be90ad22926bb97a990de957dc62.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d96e84563441ef2cef8b6253b40fb3ba9fca864e63e454ae44dc2045ef48a5e.png] 

Option 4) SW-VW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5d76ebae87e51166e2db92eeefe9ea24296b8bef1238ce54906013ad09cb6c0.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e99e6f1cc702bc9dc1bdbcf444da77bad532d9e729b88ecb5f83dd18001fa4a6.png] 

Here, '**KO-ON**' is odd among the given options.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
